import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Mint {
        long x;
        static long MOD;
        static Map<Long, Long> inv_dp = new HashMap<>();

        Mint() { x = 0; }
        Mint(long _x) {
            x = _x >= 0 ? _x % MOD : _x % MOD + MOD;
        }

        Mint pow(long b) const {
            if (b == 0) return new Mint(1);
            Mint tmp = pow(b / 2);
            return (b % 2 != 0) ? tmp.mul(tmp).mul(this) : tmp.mul(tmp);
        }

        Mint inv() const {
            if (inv_dp.containsKey(x)) {
                return new Mint(inv_dp.get(x));
            } else if (inv_dp.size() < 100000) {
                long val = pow(MOD - 2).x;
                inv_dp.put(x, val);
                return new Mint(val);
            } else {
                return pow(MOD - 2);
            }
        }

        Mint add(Mint b) { return new Mint((x + b.x) % MOD); }
        Mint sub(Mint b) { return new Mint((x - b.x + MOD) % MOD); }
        Mint mul(Mint b) { return new Mint((x * b.x) % MOD); }
        Mint div(Mint b) { return mul(b.inv()); }

        Mint addEq(Mint b) { x = (x + b.x) % MOD; return this; }
        Mint subEq(Mint b) { x = (x - b.x + MOD) % MOD; return this; }
        Mint mulEq(Mint b) { x = (x * b.x) % MOD; return this; }
        Mint divEq(Mint b) { x = (x * b.inv().x) % MOD; return this; }

        boolean equals(Mint b) { return x == b.x; }
        boolean notEquals(Mint b) { return x != b.x; }
    }

    static long[][] C = new long[600][600];
    static void precompute_comb(int n) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            C[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                C[i][j] = C[i-1][j-1] + C[i-1][j];
            }
        }
    }

    static Mint[] A = new Mint[600];
    static Mint[] B = new Mint[600];

    static long sum1(long l, long r) {
        if (l > r) return 0;
        return (l + r) * (r - l + 1) / 2;
    }

    static Mint[][][] dp = new Mint[600][600][2];
    static Mint[][][] dpc = new Mint[600][600][2];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long m = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long MOD = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        Mint.MOD = MOD;

        precompute_comb(599);

        A = new Mint[600];
        B = new Mint[600];
        for (int i = 0; i < 600; i++) {
            A[i] = new Mint(0);
            B[i] = new Mint(0);
        }

        A[0] = new Mint(0);
        B[0] = new Mint(1);
        A[1] = new Mint(0);
        B[1] = new Mint(2);
        for (int i = 2; i <= (int)m; i++) {
            Mint tmp = new Mint(0);
            Mint tmpc = new Mint(0);
            for (int l = 0; l <= i; l++) {
                int r = i - 1 - l;
                long sum_lr = sum1(1, l) + sum1(1, r);
                tmp = new Mint((tmp.x + (B[l].x * B[r].x % MOD) * sum_lr % MOD * C[i-1][l] % MOD + 
                               (A[l].x * B[r].x % MOD + A[r].x * B[l].x % MOD) * C[i-1][l] % MOD * (i + 1) % MOD) % MOD);
                tmpc = new Mint((tmpc.x + B[l].x * B[r].x % MOD * (i + 1) % MOD * C[i-1][l] % MOD) % MOD);
            }
            A[i] = tmp;
            B[i] = tmpc;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 600; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 600; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
                    dp[i][j][k] = new Mint(0);
                    dpc[i][j][k] = new Mint(0);
                }
            }
        }

        dpc[0][0][0] = new Mint(1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= (int)n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= (int)m; j++) {
                if (j > i) continue;

                dpc[i][j][0] = new Mint((dpc[i-1][j][0].x + dpc[i-1][j][1].x) % MOD);
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; k++) {
                    dpc[i][j][1] = new Mint((dpc[i][j][1].x + B[k].x * C[j][k] % MOD * dpc[i-k][j-k][0].x % MOD) % MOD);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= (int)n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= (int)m; j++) {
                if (j > i) continue;

                dp[i][j][0] = new Mint((dp[i-1][j][0].x + dp[i-1][j][1].x) % MOD);
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; k++) {
                    long term1 = A[k].x * C[j][k] % MOD * dpc[i-k][j-k][0].x % MOD;
                    long term2 = dp[i-k][j-k][0].x * B[k].x % MOD * C[j][k] % MOD;
                    dp[i][j][1] = new Mint((dp[i][j][1].x + (term1 + term2) % MOD) % MOD);
                }
            }
        }

        pw.println((dp[(int)n][(int)m][0].x + dp[(int)n][(int)m][1].x) % MOD);
        pw.close();
    }
}
